versions.label: Steam Linux (build 4940658)
versions.notes: Native x86-64 Feral port, started through Steam with FEX 2610 (glibc/PRoot route), Ubuntu 24.04, Bannerlator r9, Zink and Turnip 26.3 for Adreno 8xx at 1280x720. Keep FEX_TSOENABLED=1: a Performance/TSO-off trial left the game waiting on a forked process. Select SkyNetEmu Linux rather than Valve's pressure-vessel tool (bwrap cannot read /proc/sys/kernel/overflowuid). The launcher links the game's legacy libraries (libpcre, SDL2_image/ttf, krb5/heimdal, ldap, nettle, ...) from the installed Steam Linux Runtime (scout) into ~/.skynet/lib64/214490; without them Feral's message window cannot start. Feral shows an "unsupported graphics card or driver" advisory on every start: choose Continue Anyway. Checked 2026-11-02: start from the shortcut, advisory, intro, main menu, Continue Game from an existing campaign save (Emergency save terminal in first person) and forward movement with W, about 80-120 FPS. Not checked: long sessions, performance benchmarks, a clean exit (a standard window-close request previously ended in 'pure virtual method called' and a stuck fork; close the app instead) and other builds. Never choose Start Game with an existing campaign: it overwrites the save. FEX + bionic (the direct FEX bridge, no PRoot; its container is preferred now): the game starts from a Steam library on shared storage and renders its opening scene on a RedMagic Astra 2 (2026-11-11); gameplay and frame rate were not checked there.
